title: Run candidate source tests with an isolated machine home
when: A candidate-bound Command case empties HOME and YOKE_MACHINE_HOME to test machine-home isolation.
need: Run yoke watch pytest directly. Preserve YOKE_QA_CANDIDATE_TREE and YOKE_QA_SOURCE_ENVIRONMENT so the watcher uses the runner's recorded declaration without a control-plane connection; locked environment and import checks still apply. Invalid handoffs refuse with SOURCE-ENVIRONMENT-QA-DECLARATION and a same-case rerun recovery. Outside candidate QA the connected declaration remains required. Preserve YOKE_PG_CLUSTER_ROOT and YOKE_PG_BIN_DIR supplied before home isolation so repeated cases share one test cluster and the pinned embedded binaries. Only Yoke candidate-source cases receive these test-resource defaults; ordinary Command QA preserves its caller environment.
surface: Command case source guidance and source-development doctrine
review: Source and regression coverage; deployed behavior is not yet proven.
